title: Phase-one tooling, typed domain, authorized Supabase repository and schema
dod: Type checking and lint pass for D1 source and configurations; existing build is not regressed.

Package manifest defines pinned Bootstrap 5.3.8, installed Supabase 2.117.3 and compatible testing tools without unnecessary React or Vite upgrades. Parent may install dependencies and synchronize the lockfile after worker changes.
Snake-case domain types export Trainer, Contact, Child, ChildContact, Group, WeeklyTerm, TermAssignment and ClubData according to the agreed interface.

Repository exports createClubRepository(client) and a nullable repository singleton, providing load, saveContact, saveGroup, saveChild and saveTerm. Aggregate child/contact and term/assignment writes are atomic and preserve historical assignments.

Auth exports loadAuthorizedSession, signInTrainer, signOutTrainer, requestPasswordReset, updatePassword and subscribeToAuthChanges. Unauthorized or inactive trainers cannot access application data. Missing configuration does not crash module loading.

Migration artifact defines trainer-controlled access, enables RLS on exposed tables, prevents anonymous and authenticated non-trainer access and prevents client self-elevation. Any membership helper avoids recursive policies and uses restricted privileges and a locked search path.
Migration enforces main versus competition group eligibility, valid dates/times, required primary contact consistency and eligible nonduplicate assignments.

No remote database application, real trainer provisioning, account creation, email sending, environment modification, workflow-state modification, Git mutation, commit or push is performed by the worker.
Setup documentation describes parent installation, migration review/application and later trainer provisioning, and accurately reports that real-trainer login remains deferred.
notes: Parent applies reviewed SQL only to confirmed development project kajvevswejtmejnmiodl.
Real trainer provisioning is explicitly deferred by the user; do not grant membership to an existing account.
Contact phone is required; email and address may be null. Child birth_date is required; address and belt can remain empty during initial onboarding.
Worker may leave dependency installation to the parent rather than fail or weaken permissions for network access.
